embeddedHelp.text:
Chicken Highway – Game Rules
            
                
                Chicken Highway is a single-player risk game where players help a brave little chicken cross a busy highway to reunite with its family waiting on the other side. Each step forward increases the multiplier and potential payout. Players can cash out at any time before the chicken is hit by a vehicle. The farther the chicken goes, the greater the risk and reward. 
                
                 RTP – 97.0%
            
        

         
            Cash Out Rule
            
                
            
            Players set their bet using the + / – buttons, then follow the flow: Bet → Run → Collect (Cash Out).
            
            
            You can Cash Out at any moment before taking the next step to secure your winnings.
            CASHOUT
            With every successful jump, the multiplier increases — but if the chicken gets hit by a car after jumping to the next step, you lose your bet.
            
            Choose wisely when to cash out — the farther the chicken goes, the bigger the reward!
          


        
            Steps and Multiplier
            
                EASY
                MEDIUM
                HARD
            
            Easy Volatility – maximum 20X
            Medium Volatility – maximum 1,000X
            Hard Volatility – maximum 10,000X
        
        
        
            Bet Options
            
                TheMinimum Betper game is:0.10 DMO 
                TheMaximum Betper game is:1000.00 DMO 
                TheMaximum possiblewin is:200000.00 DMO
            
         

        
            Buttons
            
                Next possible step button
                Choose Bets – Adjust or select a predefined bet.
                Cash Out – Collect winnings before impact.
                Configure automatic runs.
                Statistics – View recent game performance.
                Menu Button – Access additional options and settings.
                Sound – Toggle sound effects and background music.
                Safe, Medium, or Hard volatility modes.
                START
                CASHOUT
                100.00
                EASY
                MEDIUM
                HARD
            

        
        
            Auto Play
            
                START
                Coefficient
                Win
                

            
            
                
                Players can activate Auto Play mode to automate consecutive rounds based on preset parameters. 
                
                    Set Number of Auto Spins – Choose how many consecutive rounds to play automatically. 
                
                
                    Set Cash Out Step – Define the multiplier (step) at which the game will automatically cash out each round. 
                
                
                    Start Playing – The chicken will automatically run, cash out, and restart until the selected number of auto spins completes, the player manually stops Auto Play, or the balance becomes insufficient for the next bet. 
                
                
                Additional Information: 
                
                    Auto Play can be stopped manually at any time. 
                
                
                    Sound & Music Controls remain available during Auto Play. 
                

            
         
        
            WHAT HAPPENS IF I GET DISCONNECTED?
            DISCONNECTION IS DEFINED AS A SITUATION WHEN A PLAYER LOSES CONNECTION TO THE SYSTEM FOR MORE THAN 8 SECONDS.
            
                If the disconnection happens in the middle of the round (when the chicken has already jumped on the multiplier), winnings will be cashed out.
If the disconnection happens during the autoplay, winnings will be cashed out.
  RTP (return to player) percentage for this game is 97.0%. The
  RTP is based on theoretical calculations and is not influenced by player
  behavior. It reflects long-term returns under standard betting conditions.
